text:
alex: Heads-up: planning a deploy for release v2.14 today at 14:00 UTC. Will be a standard DB migration + runtime bump. @maya can you confirm owners for smoke and rollback?

maya: I can own smoke. @sam will be on-call for the window. plan: 14:00 deploy, 14:10 quick smoke, 14:20 gradual routing increase.

sam: Oncall ✅. I'll monitor error budgets and latency boards. Set pager thresholds to 5% error / 200ms p50 increase.

jen: QA checklist is green aside from one flaky e2e which is unrelated to this change. I'll run the smoke playbook after deploy.

chris: Infra note: rolling update will touch 3 AZs. We should keep burst pool in place for 30m after deploy. Will rollback if health < 90% across nodes.

alex: Thanks. Release notes are here: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.14 (sharing the summary in thread). Key user-facing: improved prompt batching, small tokenizer fix, telemetry opt-in flag. No breaking API changes.

sarah-cs: Heads-up for support: we'll announce the minor feature + telemetry opt-in. No action required from CS unless customers call in with latency reports. I'll draft a short KB and share after final.

raj-marketing: We'll send a subtle product update email tomorrow morning; no launch comms needed now. If anything changes, ping marketing.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy by @alex at 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z. CI: ✅, Canary images built: 3.

maya: Quick smoke steps (copy):
```
1) curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq '.choices[0].text'
2) run perf-check: ./scripts/perf_sample.sh --tokens 256 --concurrency 5
3) validate KV cache warm: ./tools/check_kv_cache.sh
```

jen: I'll run step 1+2 and post results here.

sam: Rollback plan (short):
```
- Trigger rollback job: ./deploy/rollback.sh v2.13
- Scale back routing to 0% for v2.14 via routing API
- Revert infra changes if DB migration failed: run rollback-migration.sql
```

chris: Note on migration: it's additive, idempotent, ~2 minutes per shard. We tested on staging with 12 shards. Keep an eye on replication lag.

alex: If everyone is ✅, I'll flip the deploy to 'ready' at 13:50 UTC and run preflight smoke at 13:55. Please be available 13:50-14:30.

maya: ✅ available. Jen, Sam, Chris all set?

jen: ✅

sam: ✅ on-call nearby.

chris: ✅ infra covered.

sarah-cs: I'll standby for escalations.

raj-marketing: good from our side.

alex: Great — final call: proceeding unless someone raises a block before 13:50. :rocket:
